description: Land Acquisition - Kelaniya, Kelaniya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific parcels of land for public purposes. It provides detailed descriptions of multiple land plots, including their locations, extents, assessments, and claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
